title: spinalmodes: Information-Cosserat mechanics of the developing spine (AIS modelling framework)
description: Open-source computational framework underlying the manuscript 'Information-Cosserat Mechanics of Scoliosis'. Cosserat-rod spine simulations, cross-species allometric analysis (Bg = EI/MgL^2), AlphaFold-derived protein structural metrics, two-timescale recovery-ratchet model of curve setting, and bracing simulation calibrated against BrAIST. No human-subject data.
